title: 第15章 晴儿的变化第16章 诡异的功法
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
晴儿睁着美丽的大眼睛看着熟睡的黄夜，眼角滑落滴滴泪水。
奇怪，前两天问少爷的时候，他还说以后再要，怎么刚才如此狂暴地要了？
心里早早地盼着这一天到来，只是过程跟以前听说的不一样呢？
开始的时候，少爷很粗暴，像个疯子一样，还弄痛了她。
尤其是那双眼睛好像在燃烧，少爷的身体也很烫，像发烧了一样。
后来适应了，才有一种舒服的感觉。
还有另外一种感觉，从少爷那里传过来一股热流。
这热流竟然在她的全身运转一圈，最后又回到少爷那里。
热流好像生生不息的样子，一直在两人体内流动。
结束后，自己没有丝毫疲惫感，反而感觉精神头很足。
未经人事的她自然不明白是什么道理，但那种感觉让她觉得很爽。
虽然少爷昨天狂暴地要了她，但她心中只有高兴。
哪怕少爷没有任何话语，她也觉得很幸福。
这是她从小立下的夙愿，终于得偿所愿。
咦！什么味道？
有淡淡的臭味，还有淡淡的香味，两种味道混合在一起好怪异。
仔细闻了闻，香味好像是自己身体散发出来的，臭味还是少爷散发的。
赶紧收好撕碎的肚兜和亵裤，轻轻起身下床。
咦！怎么感觉身子轻了许多，不应该是痛么？
难道是府里的婆婆们骗人呢？

不想了，还是先打扫战场吧。
高高兴兴地去下屋烧了一盆水。
回来把黄夜的身体擦拭干净，给他换了一套内衣裤。
那张带着血花的床单则被她珍而重之地收起来。
少爷睡得好香，这么折腾他都不醒。
给黄夜盖好被，自己也烧了一盆水，把身体擦拭得干干净净。
一切收拾妥当，天色已见亮，重新躺回床上，呆呆地看着黄夜。
心里却想着刚才的怪事。
自己的力量好像大了很多，端满满一盆水，仿佛轻若无物。
给少爷擦身子的时候也能轻松翻动少爷，最后换床单时竟然能把躺尸的少爷抱起来。
自己的脚步也轻快许多，在外面特意试了一下。
content_en:
Qing'er opened her beautiful big eyes and looked at the sleeping Huang Ye, with tears falling from the corners of her eyes.
It's strange. When I asked the young master two days ago, he said he would ask for it later. Why did he ask for it so violently just now?
I have been looking forward to this day for a long time, but the process is different from what I heard before?
At the beginning, the young master was very rough, like a madman, and even hurt her.
Especially those eyes seemed to be burning, and the young master's body was also very hot, as if he had a fever.
After I got used to it, I felt comfortable.
There was another feeling, a warm current coming from the young master.
The heat circulated throughout her body and finally returned to the young master.
The heat seemed to be endless, always flowing in the two bodies.
After finishing, I didn't feel tired at all, but felt very energetic.
Naturally, she didn't understand what it meant, but the feeling made her feel very happy.
Although the young master wanted her violently yesterday, she was only happy in her heart.
Even if the young master didn't say anything, she felt very happy.
This was her long-cherished wish since childhood, and she finally got it.
Hey! What does it taste like?
There is a faint odor and a faint fragrance. The two flavors mix together so weirdly.
After sniffing carefully, the scent seemed to be emanating from my own body, but the stench was emanating from the young master.
Quickly put away the torn bellyband and underpants, and gently got up and got out of bed.
Hey! Why do I feel so much lighter? Shouldn't it be pain?
Could it be that the mothers-in-law in the house were lying?
I don’t want to think about it anymore, let’s clean up the battlefield first.
I happily went downstairs to boil a basin of water.
When he came back, he wiped Huang Ye's body clean and changed him into a set of underwear.
The sheet with bloody flowers was put away by her with great care.
The young master slept so soundly that he didn't even wake up after all this trouble.
After covering Huang Ye with a quilt, he also boiled a basin of water and wiped his body clean.
After everything was packed up and it was already dawn, I lay back on the bed and stared blankly at Huang Ye.
But I was thinking about the strange thing just now.
My strength seems to be much stronger, holding a basin full of water seems as light as nothing.
He could easily turn the young master over when he was wiping his body. Finally, when changing the sheets, he was able to pick up the young master lying dead.
My steps were much lighter, so I tried it outside.
